name: Deploy to GitHub Pages with Version Bump

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: deploy
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository (full history)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Git user
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Read and bump version
        id: bump
        run: |
          VERSION_FILE="_includes/VERSION.txt"
          if [ ! -f "$VERSION_FILE" ]; then
            echo "Error: $VERSION_FILE not found" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(cat "$VERSION_FILE")
          if ! [[ "$CURRENT_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: $VERSION_FILE does not contain a valid integer" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          NEW_VERSION=$((CURRENT_VERSION + 1))
          printf "%d" "$NEW_VERSION" > "$VERSION_FILE"
          echo "new_version=$NEW_VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Commit version bump
        run: |
          git add _includes/VERSION.txt
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to ${{ steps.bump.outputs.new_version }}"
          git push origin main

      - name: Create and push tag
        run: |
          TAG="v${{ steps.bump.outputs.new_version }}"
          if git rev-parse "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Tag $TAG already exists. Skipping tag creation."
          else
            git tag -a "$TAG" -m "Release $TAG"
            git push origin "$TAG"
          fi

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.3
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install Jekyll dependencies
        run: |
          if [ -f Gemfile ]; then
            bundle install
          else
            gem install jekyll bundler
          fi

      - name: Build Jekyll site
        run: |
          if [ -f Gemfile ]; then
            bundle exec jekyll build
          else
            jekyll build
          fi

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: _site
          commit-message: "Deploy: version ${{ steps.bump.outputs.new_version }}"
          clean: true
